baslik: NASA Crashed a Boeing 720 on Purpose — Then It Exploded

sahneler.metin: NASA crashed a real four-engine jetliner on purpose.
It hit the ground and exploded in a fireball within seconds.
It was not supposed to burn at all.
Its fuel carried an additive meant to stop misting.
Spilled fuel sprays into a fine mist, and mist burns explosively.
Blades on the runway were built to rip open the wing tanks.
But the plane landed off-center, and an engine lit the fuel.
The additive failed, and the idea was abandoned.

aciklama:
On December 1, 1984, NASA and the FAA crashed a remotely flown Boeing 720 to test anti-misting fuel. It was meant to prevent a fireball. It didn't.
